## 1. Product Categories & Technical Specifications

### A. Builder in a Bottle (BIAB) & Rubber Base Gel
- URL: https://gznewnail.com/oem/biab-rubber-base-gel-manufacturer.html
- Primary Use: Apex building, natural nail strengthening overlays, short extensions, ridge filling.
- Viscosity: 3,500 - 5,500 mPa.s (controlled self-leveling flow).
- Color Range: 50+ shades including Cover Pink, Milky White, Nude Beige, Sheer Peach, Jelly Rose, and Opal Shimmer.
- Formulations: Standard flexible resin, HEMA-Free, TPO-Free, and synthetic fiber-reinforced formulas.
- Curing Requirement: 60s under 48W/72W 365+405nm LED UV nail lamp.
- Removal: 10-15 minute acetone soak-off or e-file removal.
- Available Formats: 15ml customized retail bottles, 500ml HDPE refill bottles, 1KG bulk containers.

### B. Water-Permeable Halal Nail Polish
- URL: https://gznewnail.com/oem/halal-water-permeable-nail-polish-factory.html
- Technology: Micro-porous polymer matrix facilitating water vapor and liquid transmission for Wudu ritual compliance.
- Compliance: 100% Vegan, Cruelty-Free, Alcohol-Free, 15-Free clean cosmetic formula.
- Color Portfolio: 300+ shades (Creme, Nude, Pastel, Shimmer, Metallic, Glitter).
- Drying Time: 60 - 90 seconds air-dry without UV lamp.
- Packaging: 10ml, 12ml, 15ml high-clarity glass bottles with custom brush and cap options.

### C. UV/LED Gel Polish System
- URL: https://gznewnail.com/products/private-label-gel-polish/
- Core Categories: Pure Color Gel, Platinum Glitter Gel, Cat Eye Magnetic Gel, Blooming Gel, Jelly Tint Gel.
- Durability: 28+ days wear time without chipping or peeling.
- Safety: Low-odor, acid-free bonding, HEMA-Free option available.

### D. Functional Base & Top Gel Systems
- Base Coats: Thin Base Gel, Thick Rubber Base, Acid-Free Primer & Bonder, Fiber Base.
- Top Coats: No-Wipe Diamond High Gloss Top, Tempered Scratch-Resistant Top, Velvet Matte Top, Chrome Mirror Powder Sealer Top Coat.

### E. Acrylic & Dipping Powder Systems
- URL: https://gznewnail.com/products/acrylic-dipping-system/
- Polymers: Extra-fine sifted acrylic powder, buttery workability, non-yellowing optical brighteners.
- Monomer: 100% EMA (Ethyl Methacrylate) professional monomer liquid, zero MMA, low-odor all-season formula.
- Dipping Glue System: Step 1 Prep, Step 2 Base, Step 3 Activator, Step 4 Top, Brush Saver.

### F. 3-in-1 Matching Color Kit Systems (Gel + Lacquer + Dip Powder)

- Product Page: https://gznewnail.com/products/product-kits/3-in-1-matching-color-nail-kit.html

- Commercial Standard: Low MOQ from 100 sets, 3–5 day color matching samples, 10–14 day bulk dispatch. Fully HEMA-Free, 15-Free, and MoCRA/EU 1223/2009 compliant.

### G. Professional Cuticle Care & Salon Retail Series (Oils, Balms, Pens)
- Guide: https://gznewnail.com/guides/winter-cuticle-oil-pen-salon-retail-guide.html
- Core Formulations: Cold-Pressed Golden Jojoba Oil, Sweet Almond Oil, Hydrolyzed Keratin, Tocopherol (USP Vitamin E), Pro-Vitamin B5 (D-Panthenol). Zero Mineral Oil, 100% Vegan.
- Seasonal Scents: Warm Vanilla Crème, Spiced Sugar Plum, Frosted Winter Pine, Midnight Velvet Rose, and 0% Fragrance-Free Hypoallergenic.
- Applicator Formats: 2ml/3ml/5ml Precision Twist-Up Nylon Brush Pens with Anti-Leak Silicone Relief Valves, 15ml/30ml Borosilicate Glass Droppers, and 12-Pack/24-Pack POP Countertop Retail Display Merchandising Sets.
- Commercial Standard: Low MOQ from 100 pcs (stock pens with logo) / 500 pcs (custom holiday fragrance & bespoke retail box), 3–5 day sample dispatch, 85%+ salon retail gross profit margin. Full US FDA MoCRA & EU CPNP PIF compliance.

### H. Special Effects, Reflective Disco Flash & 9D Velvet Cat-Eye Gel System
- Guide: https://gznewnail.com/guides/nye-winter-reflective-flash-velvet-cat-eye-gel-sourcing-guide.html
- Core Technologies: 15–35μm high-refraction retro-reflective optical glass microspheres ($n \ge 1.93$) and silane-passivated superparamagnetic rare-earth iron flakes.
- Performance: Dual-state optical effect (daytime elegance + blinding camera flash explosion), 360° fluid velvet satin halo without muddy grey undertones.
- Curing & Compliance: 100% EU TPO-Free & HEMA-Free using dual-wavelength BAPO/TPO-L photoinitiators, zero heat spikes under 48W LED lamps, complete depth curing in 60s.
- Commercial Standard: Low MOQ from 100 bottles per color in 15ml luxury bottles, custom 6/12-color festive holiday gift sets from 500 sets, 3–5 day physical sample dispatch.

### I. Valentine's Day & Early Spring Romantic Gel & Care Systems (2027 Season)
- Guide: https://gznewnail.com/guides/valentines-early-spring-gel-and-romantic-care-sourcing-guide.html
- Core Formulations: Translucent Sheer Rose & Peach French Jellies, Glazed Donut Pearl Chrome & Aurora powders (synthetic fluorophlogopite), Non-Wipe 3D Sculpture & Heart Embossing Gels, and Romance Glass Cat-Eye Gel.
- Anti-Yellowing Technology: Hindered Amine Light Stabilizers (HALS) and optical violet brighteners preventing pale pinks and milky whites from yellowing over 28+ days of salon wear.
- Add-On Retail Companion Lines: Damask Rose & White Peach Cuticle Oil Twist Pens (85%+ margin, 12-pack counter POP displays), 30g Hyaluronic Acid + Shea Butter Velvet Hand Creams, and 3-in-1 Matching Color Kits.
- Commercial Standard: Low MOQ from 100 bottles per shade, bespoke 3-shade and 6-shade luxury boxed gift sets, 3–5 day rapid sample dispatch, 10–14 day bulk turnaround. Fully EU 2026 TPO-Free, HEMA-Free, and US MoCRA compliant.

### J. Easter & Spring 2027 Pastel Macaron Cream Gel, Milky BIAB & Sunscreen Systems
- Guide: https://gznewnail.com/guides/easter-spring-pastel-macaron-gel-sourcing-guide.html
- Core Formulations: Butter Yellow, Pistachio Mint, Lilac Blossom, Baby Peach, Cloud Sky Blue thixotropic single-stroke butter cream gels with nano-milled non-streaking pigments.
- Natural Overlay System: 45% Translucent Sheer Milky White & Peach BIAB Builder in a Bottle for Clean Girl and Soap Nails trend, self-leveling apex creation, keratin reinforcement.
- Anti-Yellowing Sunscreen Chemistry: Triple Optical Shield featuring Hindered Amine Light Stabilizers (HALS) + UV Absorbers + Optical Violet Filters, 100% 2026 EU TPO-Ban compliant (TPO-L/BAPO photoinitiators), 0% HEMA.
- Companion Salon Care Lines: 30g Light Water-Gel Aloe Vera & Triple Hyaluronic Acid Hand Serums (89%+ margin), Spring Botanical Cuticle Oil Pens (12-pack POP counter displays), and 6-Shade Easter Capsule Collection Boxes.
- Commercial Standard: Low MOQ from 100 bottles per shade, 3–5 day custom color lab matching samples, 10–14 day bulk turnaround with full ISO 22716, FDA MoCRA & EU CPNP certifications.

## 3. Quality Assurance, Testing & Compliance Standards

- Good Manufacturing Practice: ISO 22716:2007 Cosmetics GMP certified facility.
- Certificate Validity: Facility certificate issued September 19, 2026, valid through June 30, 2027.
- Laboratory Documentation: Comprehensive SDS (GHS format), COA (Certificate of Analysis) per production batch.
- Regulatory Compliance Support:
  - United States: FDA MoCRA facility registration and cosmetic product listing assistance.
  - European Union & United Kingdom: CPNP / SCPN cosmetic notification ingredient breakdown and CPSR formulation review.
- Testing Demonstrations: Water-permeability lab test video available upon request for Halal buyers.
